verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows GlitchTip offering its own cross-project or cross-team trend dashboards, top-regression views, new-issues-per-release reporting, or error volume over time. The site explicitly advertises 'no dashboard building' (docs-6). The Grafana Sentry data source (docs-13) is an external tool and earns no credit, and release creation via the CLI (docs-5) is not the same as per-release issue analytics.
